spoon_daiso_pink.evidence: Daiso 4550480456553 lists complete scoop 10 x 26 x 4 cm. User photos IMG_9956-9960 show detached head with short socket, not the full handle. Width uses nominal 100 mm; head length/profile/thickness/relief and mass are photo-based estimates. Bowl must be concave inside, convex outside, with recessed inner crown and raised outer crown. Wall revised to nominal 3 mm across the sloping material, with a 2 mm outward rounded lip and flattened rim transition. Thickness and edge profile are authored estimates responding to user review, not measurements. Socket blend and local smoothing are photo-informed estimates for the handle-to-bowl transition.
